1.title: Modeling Basics — Variables, Constraints & Objective
1.description: Learn step by step how to turn plain problem descriptions into decision variables, linear inequalities, 0-1 binary choices, multi-period inventory flow, and mixed-integer linking constraints.

2.title: Linearization Idioms, Convex QP & LP Duality
2.description: Charnes-Cooper ratio linearization, minimax epigraphs, positive-part slacks, robust L1/Linf fitting, convex quadratic portfolios, shadow prices, and reduced-cost sensitivity.

3.title: Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) Formulation Idioms
3.description: Fixed-charge lot sizing, indicator directions, chained logic, SOS2 piecewise approximation, McCormick envelopes, and pattern enumeration.

4.title: Propositional Logic & SMT Modeling
4.description: Uniqueness proofs via no-good cuts, logic refutation, policy verification, minimal Unsat Core extraction, MaxSAT repair, and SMT-LIRA.

5.title: Constraint Programming (CP / LCG) & Global Constraints
5.description: AllDifferent (distinct), Element (at), Table (allowed), NoOverlap (disjoint), Cumulative scheduling, 2D packing, symmetry breaking, and MIP vs CP vs SMT comparison.

6.title: Networks, Total Unimodularity, Connectivity & Vehicle Routing
6.description: Exploit total unimodularity, max-flow min-cut, flow-based connectivity without subtours, CVRP, VRPTW, and connected territory design.

7.title: Production, Inventory, Supply Chain & Energy Systems
7.description: Strong lot-sizing reformulations, multi-level BOM/MRP, backorders vs lost sales, facility location (CFLP), Unit Commitment, and battery arbitrage.

8.title: Scheduling, Staff Rostering, Timetabling & Revenue Management
8.description: Job-shop comparison (MIP vs CP), RCPSP, rolling night-rest rosters, university timetabling, OR scheduling, and seat allocation.

9.title: Model Auditing, Multi-Objective Tradeoffs & Uncertainty
9.description: Historical constraint auditing, infeasibility diagnosis, goal/lexicographic tradeoffs, Pareto curves, Hamming-distance rescheduling, CVaR, and robust optimization.

10.title: Large-Scale Decomposition & Hybrid Solvers
10.description: Lazy cuts, cutting-stock/VRP column generation, Dantzig-Wolfe, classical & logic-based Benders decomposition, Lagrangian relaxation, LNS, and S&OP synthesis.
